transcript: Hello Ji very good afternoon sir main Harshita baat kar rahi thi India Mall ki aapka ek business firm hai Shri Aram Enterprises uske regarding connect kiya tha sir maine Theek hai. Haan ji sir jaise main dekh rahi thi aapke already pehle bhi hamari team se baat hui hai meeting bhi hui hai toh aapki profile pe sir aapke product ke regarding toh achhi inquiry generate ho rahi hai sir jaise main dekh rahi hoon hamare paas kaafi requirements aayi hui hai already abhi Hello Haan haan boliye Haan ji haan ji kaafi requirements hamare paas abhi aayi hui hai aapke product ke regarding toh ispe aap wholesale kar rahe ho na sir abhi Detail kar rahe hain. Retail kar rahe ho to wholesale mein abhi matlab bulk inquiries agar aapko aati hai product ke regarding to aap wholesale price mein deal karte hain aur retail mein hi karte hain Bulk to wholesale mein hi hoga na. Obviously wholesale price mein karte honge then sir aap matlab wholesale retail dono hi kar rahe hain na aap Okay toh supply kahan tak hai sir aapka all over Jharkhand ya phir Nahi nahi raat hi aaspaas karte hain. Accha matlab hundred hundred fifty kilometer ke andar provide karte hain na Hai Hello Haan ji haan ji haan ji toh sir jaise ki abhi aapka yeh free listed profile registered tha toh kaafi saari inquiries vagairah available hai aap apne end se jaise ki aapke paas app uninstalled hai toh aap dekh sakte hain ki aap by lead section pe aapke profile pe kuch inquiry vagairah aayi hui hai product ke regarding Haan Aur jaise ki aap hamare saath jab on board karte ho na proper profile se toh hum aapko kuch sure shot customer provide karke dete hain aur like customer jo hoti hai sir hamare wo verified customer hote hain matlab genuine customer hote hain jo hum aapko poore month mein kuch numbers mein provide karke dete hain like jaise ki sixty to seventy ke around Hum Aur uske saath mein sir hum aapka jaise catalog designing karna ho gaya, kuch features hain hamare jismein catalog designing karna ho gaya, aapko sir PNS number provide karte hain aur catalog designing mein sir sabse jo main point hota hai aapka product product ki images hoti hai available usmein do teen angles se, jismein product aapka clear dikh raha hota hai ki kis product kya product hai aapka, kis product pe aap deal kar rahe ho, uske keywords map hote hain proper jiske through sir aapki inquiry wagairah aati hai customers ki and usmein pricing wagairah saari cheez. Mention rehti hai. Aur Toh main chah rahi thi sir ki kaafi saare features bhi hain toh on the call saari cheezein yeh discussion ho nahi paati hai basically toh main uske regarding aapse ek baar sir face to face mil karke uske meetings chah rahi thi jaise hamara ek demonstration bhi hai India Mart ka toh woh bhi ho jayega and aapko India Mart ke benefits wagairah bhi aapke business ke regarding kya provide hoga woh pata chal jayegi toh sir aapka shop kahan pe hai Ranchi mein Koti mod mein hai Booti Mor mein kahan pe hai sir location bata sakte hain Kotimo chowk mein hai SBI bank building mein. Booti Mool Chowk mein koi landmark Tanaka Sarna Palace hai SBI Bank SBI Bank. SBI Bank nearby mein hai Haan, usi building mein hai. Okay usi building mein kitne floor base hai Grams Ground floor mein hi hai Okay toh aaj aap kitne baje tak available rahenge sir Toh yahi rehte hain. Okay matlab abhi bhi aap usi location pe ho na Main aapko ek baar WhatsApp pe hi like karke message kar rahi hoon aap mujhe apna location current location share kar sakte hain Nahi toh local banda toh aapko pata hai jo yahan ka banda hai na aapka. Hum Usko toh pata hai. Okay location aapke already pata hai unko. Theek hai sir aapke location pe jo bhi map ho rahe hain sir vo aap ek baar aapke location pe visit kar lenge and aapko saari cheezein details mein ek baar explain kar denge kya hai. Kaasa hai vo aaya hai Pata hi hai na usko sab pata hai pehle bhi aaya hua hai visit hua hua tha Haan ji haan ji Ji toh mujhe woh jaankari sab bataya hua hai pehle bhi Hmm hmm To jaise sir main dekh rahi thi ki aapki last meeting jo hamari team ke saath hui thi na vo aapka sir September mein hua tha. To September se sir December tak kaafi saare features hamare change ho gaye the aur abhi January mein sir hamara package mein bhi kaafi saara features change hua hai upgrade hua hai matlab pehle hamara designing mein panch days lagta tha ya ek week ka time lagta tha but abhi aap sir instant aap vo designing vagairah complete karke hum provide kar rahe hain aap same day se leads vagairah use kar paoge. To yeh saara aapko features mein bahut saari Changes bhi aayi hui hai. Theek hai? Toh uske regarding hi abhi jaise obviously sir business aapka bhi hai toh aap dekh rahe hoge September se abhi tak mein kaafi saare product aapne hataenge, kaafi saare add on kiya hoga aapne. Hai na? Toh business bhi jaise change hote rehta hai, update hote rehta hai yaar main toh usi tarike se hamara features bhi kaafi saara change hua hai. Toh main ek baar chah rahi thi ki aap isse update raho atleast and then phir sir iske regarding aapko decisions bhi lene mein easy padenge. Toh main isliye chah rahi thi aaj ki meeting agar aap time de pao sir koi toh. Aapki kya rahegi kyonki hamare liye sir aapka available hona aur aapka sir time dena hamare liye important hai Ye main yahin hoon bhaiya bhaji Okay toh abhi sir aapka pachas bhaag aath ho raha hai main aapka ek sau ka ma'am meeting fix kar rahi hoon aap ek sau mein lunch ke liye aap jaate ho sir ek baje ya ek baje ke around ya phir aap wahi available rehte ho Ji Kaun pe rahe hain Hello sir aapki voice break ho rahi hai Haan haan rahenge rahenge Rahenge hi na theek hai toh main ek sau se do PM ke around tak hamare field executive aapko visit kar lenge and aapko saari cheezein achhe se details mein explain kar denge sir. Theek Okay thank you sir.
